Responses recorded from https://rest.pubmlst.org on 2026-11-18, without a
login. `db_list.json` and `neisseria_schemes.json` keep 4 of the 90 groups and
4 of the 93 Neisseria schemes. `neisseria_st11_mlst_loci.fasta` is the seven
MLST alleles of Neisseria ST-11 (abcZ 2, adk 3, aroE 4, fumC 3, gdh 8, pdhC 4,
pgm 6). The `type_abcz_1snp_*` files are abcZ allele 2 with one base changed
at position 101, typed without and with `partial_matches`.
